requirements.title: Tick command executes single health cycle
requirements.description: vrooli-autoheal tick runs platform detection, bootstrap, watchdog verification, and all health checks once

requirements.title: Tick command emits structured output
requirements.description: Tick outputs JSON-formatted health results when --json flag is provided

requirements.title: Loop command runs continuously
requirements.description: While loop mode is active, vrooli-autoheal loop shall run the tick lifecycle repeatedly, backing off on healable failures and resetting the wait on the first healthy tick, until a shutdown signal arrives.

validation.notes: Healable failures back off from one minute doubling to fifteen; the first healthy tick resets. Loop tests carry no [REQ:CLI-LOOP-*] tag (cli/loop is outside this phase's edit set), so sync cannot earn this status from live evidence until the tests are tagged.
A signal during the inter-tick sleep ends the loop with exit 0.

requirements.title: Loop interval is configurable
requirements.description: vrooli-autoheal loop shall read --interval (seconds, default 60) into Config.TickInterval and shall pause exactly one tick interval between non-healable retries.

validation.notes: Asserts every non-healable retry sleeps exactly config.TickInterval. No test exercises parseFlags(--interval) itself; that gap is real. Loop tests carry no [REQ:CLI-LOOP-*] tag (cli/loop is outside this phase's edit set), so sync cannot earn this status from live evidence until the tests are tagged.

requirements.title: Loop handles errors gracefully
requirements.description: If a tick or preflight fails, then vrooli-autoheal loop shall classify the failure: healable failures degrade and retry with backoff, alive-but-failing ticks degrade without restarting the API, and non-healable (usage) failures write the status file and exit 3 after three attempts.

validation.notes: Usage errors exit 3 after three attempts, status file names the class, no breaker slot spent. Loop tests carry no [REQ:CLI-LOOP-*] tag (cli/loop is outside this phase's edit set), so sync cannot earn this status from live evidence until the tests are tagged.

requirements.title: Boolean global flags consume one argv token
requirements.description: When the vrooli CLI is invoked with --no-color, the root argv parser shall consume exactly that one token and, with no command following, shall fall through to help without panicking.

validation.notes: Evidence lives in the control plane (internal/cli/rootcli), verified by `go test ./internal/cli/rootcli/`; test-genie's scenario suite does not run it, so sync cannot earn this status. Phase 1 of the boot-recovery plan; failing-before capture at /home/matthalloran8/.vrooli/plan-artifacts/boot-recovery-readiness/evidence/p01/failing-before.txt.

requirements.title: Retired globals are tolerated, unknown flags rejected
requirements.description: If a supervisor unit invokes vrooli with a retired global flag (such as --no-stale-check before its removal date), then the CLI shall consume it with one warning and never a usage error; an unknown leading flag shall remain a hard error.

validation.notes: Evidence lives in the control plane (internal/cli/rootcli), verified by `go test ./internal/cli/rootcli/`; test-genie's scenario suite does not run it, so sync cannot earn this status. Phase 1 of the boot-recovery plan; failing-before capture at /home/matthalloran8/.vrooli/plan-artifacts/boot-recovery-readiness/evidence/p01/failing-before.txt.

requirements.title: Every registered command path resolves
requirements.description: The vrooli CLI shall resolve every registered command path through the root argv parser without executing it, so a supervisor's argv (`vrooli scenario start`, `vrooli-autoheal tick`) can be checked before a unit is installed.
